name: pawball-chronicles
description: PawBall Chronicles — AI-powered cat collection platform

scripts.dev: concurrently -n web,api -c blue,green "npm run dev --workspace=apps/web" "npm run dev --workspace=apps/api"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=packages/shared-types && npm run build --workspace=apps/web && npm run build --workspace=apps/api
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace=apps/web && npm run lint --workspace=apps/api
scripts.clean: rm -rf apps/web/.next apps/web/node_modules apps/api/dist apps/api/node_modules packages/shared-types/dist packages/shared-types/node_modules node_modules
